scope: Independent source-only review of frozen S2 CSR v2 overlay; no production edits or execution.

observations.finding: CSR accepts namespace/keyID/generation instead of a retained PendingKey as authority. It uses current() checked manifest, ready state, exact module random application tag, RSA private key query, public class/type/2048-bit checks and the stored public-key digest. current().encoded is checked again before signing and before return.

PKCS10 uses exact DER CRI version0, subject, rsaEncryption+NULL SPKI with public PKCS1 bytes in a zero-unused-bit BIT STRING, mandatory empty A000 attributes, and sha256WithRSAEncryption+NULL. SecKeyCreateSignature message algorithm signs these exact CRI bytes, followed by actual public SecKeyVerifySignature before publishing public DER.

Each new Copy/Create/Verify CFError output is consumed once with takeRetainedValue. Input CN/email iteration is bounded before allocation; CN is nonempty <=64 scalars without C0/C1 controls, email is <=128 printable ASCII with one non-edge @. DER output is <=8192 bytes. DN is encoded as literal ASN1 values, not slash syntax; trace contains operation/byte count/main flag only, not subject or key data.

Three new SDK definitions use the existing fixture detached worker, actual permanent RSA generation and actual Vault resume/loadKey, parse returned CSR with the independent CMS DER reader, import its public key and verify its exact signature plus tampered CRI rejection. They also check old publication/manifest retention, stale/foreign/revoked/deleted-key refusal, bounded invalid subjects and cancellation. They are definitions only, not observed Security execution.

limitations: Synchronous actor confinement and before/after manifest equality do not form cross-process locking/CAS or invalidate already-borrowed raw SecKey references.
Key-only CSR creation conveys no Apple account/remote authorization, certificate issuance, profile authority, installation permission or whole automatic-renewal completion.
Subject policy is the explicitly bounded supported form, not a complete email/DN validation engine; public CSR bytes intentionally contain supplied CN/email.
Native Swift/Security types, Keychain reopen behavior and CSR signatures still need actual concentrated SDK execution; grammar was neither rerun nor treated as typecheck.
This unmerged two-file overlay is outside frozen currentcore314/316 and Package16 selection.
